## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
Sector Rotation, not Risk-Off. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5) and Value/Cyclical style favored; note MAJOR divergence across large caps — watch for trend break.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Financials lead: COF (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +20.25%) ABOVE TREND, PNC (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +17.68%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +5.24%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Discretionary strong: TSLA (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +20.11%) ABOVE TREND, GM (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +15.88%) ABOVE TREND. Materials: FCX (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +20.99%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Utilities weak with rotation signals: EXC (1W: +1.02% | 1M: -6.18%) RECOVERY, DUK (1W: +1.47% | 1M: -7.59%) RECOVERY, AEP (1W: +0.00% | 1M: -7.73%) BELOW TREND. Energy soft: EOG (1W: -8.68% | 1M: -7.05%) BELOW TREND, VLO (1W: -7.28% | 1M: -7.95%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -2.42%) BELOW TREND. Communication mixed/weak: GOOGL (1W: -4.62% | 1M: +7.23%) CORRECTION, NFLX (1W: +1.65% | 1M: -14.56%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: EL (1W: -2.92% | 1M: +21.43%) CORRECTION, FCX (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +20.99%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +20.25%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +20.11%) ABOVE TREND, USB (1W: -0.09% | 1M: +17.68%) CORRECTION. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: ORCL (1W: -15.24% | 1M: -14.02%) BELOW TREND, AMD (1W: -5.90% | 1M: -13.37%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -8.59% | 1M: -6.65%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -8.68% | 1M: -7.05%) BELOW TREND, VLO (1W: -7.28% | 1M: -7.95%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech and Energy names.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Best 1W momentum: TSLA (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +20.11%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +5.81%) ABOVE TREND, GM (1W: +5.70% | 1M: +15.88%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND, BMY (1W: +5.38% | 1M: +15.28%) ABOVE TREND. MAJOR Divergence flagged (AAPL, GOOGL, NVDA, GS among others with 1W vs 1M mismatch) — tactical opportunities, not core confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Mixed with net internal rotation; Tech: 11/19 positive. META (1W: +1.36% | 1M: +9.46%) ABOVE TREND contrasts with NVDA (1W: -3.71% | 1M: -5.16%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -0.43% | 1M: -5.93%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -1.55% | 1M: +2.61%) CORRECTION.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Robust and broad; Financials: 16/20 positive. COF (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +20.25%) ABOVE TREND, PNC (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +17.68%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +5.24%) ABOVE TREND — sector leadership confirms cyclical tilt.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Defensive but selective; Healthcare: 11/15 positive. JNJ (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +5.61%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.05% | 1M: +4.22%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +5.50% | 1M: +2.60%) ABOVE TREND while PFE (1W: -2.04% | 1M: +0.70%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Financials and cyclicals (COF, PNC, JPM, FCX, TSLA) given broad leadership and sector breadth; reduce exposure to stretched Tech names showing BELOW TREND (NVDA, MSFT, ORCL). Style: Value/Cyclical over Growth for now, but MAJOR divergence advises selectivity and waiting for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: TSLA (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +20.11%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +20.99%) ABOVE TREND, COF (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +20.25%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -15.24% | 1M: -14.02%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -3.71% | 1M: -5.16%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -8.68% | 1M: -7.05%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Financials (Breadth: 16/20 positive) and Consumer Discretionary (Breadth: 9/12 positive) on cyclical rotation.  
BEARISH: Utilities (Breadth: 1/6 positive) and Energy (Breadth: 2/8 positive) remain vulnerable.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Watch NVDA reclaiming its 1M trend (shift BELOW TREND → RECOVERY) as a trigger for Tech sentiment; AAPL holding 1M support would reduce correction risk; JPM sustaining ABOVE TREND momentum would confirm Financials leadership; ORCL breach continuation would signal deeper Tech weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Rotation with a Value/Cyclical tilt given breadth (8/11 sectors positive) and Financials leadership. COF (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +20.25%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +9.10% | 1M: +20.11%) ABOVE TREND and FCX (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +20.99%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is MAJOR divergence among large caps (AAPL, GOOGL, NVDA, GS) — watch for trend breaks and treat moves as tactical until confirmed.
